name: launch_specialist
description: Eval adapter for launching an allowlisted Waykit specialist. The live parent does not call this tool: it opens ~/.cursor/agents/<name>.md as a Cursor Task (or ~/.claude/agents). Pass the same fields as wk agents launch-prompt (specialist, class, handover paths, Linear id, DoD, Next agent). Do not launch stack profiles. Do not split TDD gear 1 and gear 2.

handoverPaths.description: Handover files the child must read or write

linearId.description: Linear issue id when the session plays a ticket
